_about: The example project's stand-in interview: a FICTIONAL founder of the fictional Example Co., answering the seeded questions in engines/interview/QUESTIONS.md. make-example.mjs speaks these lines to make footage/interview.mp4, so the whole pipeline runs before you record anything. Nothing here is a real company, person, or figure.

steps.text: I'm Sam Rivera, and I'm the founder of Example Co.
Before this, I spent six years running the front desk at a busy dental clinic.
Example Co. is a scheduling app that fills last-minute cancellations for dental clinics. When a patient cancels, we text the waiting list and book the first person who says yes.
I started it because I watched empty chairs cost our clinic real money, every single week.
It's for clinic managers, the people who spend their mornings on the phone trying to fill a gap.
With Example Co., that gap fills itself, and the manager gets their morning back.
If you run a clinic, try it for a month, and count the chairs you fill.
